ambient: Something happens. The sound of it catches up.
You move, and a moment later the movement is reported.
The fault does not correct itself. It holds steady, competently.
description: The room is running about half a second behind the soundtrack of the room, and you are on the soundtrack. You watch yourself decide things and then watch the decision arrive. It is not distressing. It is a technical fault in a building you happen to be inside.
name: Out Of Sync

looks: Half a second, held very consistently.
You test it by moving a hand. The hand agrees, late, in good faith.
It is not getting worse. It has been set.
objects.name: the gap

looks: It arrives after the shape of saying it, and it is definitely yours.
You say something short to check. The checking takes longer than the sentence did.
It has a room on it that this room does not have.
objects.name: your own voice

weather: The air moves half a second after the thing that moved it.
